privacy.body_redaction: Sandbox account login IDs appearing as public forum author text were replaced. Each affected record retains only the original response body SHA-256 and the redacted body.

general_rules.observation: files/PageFilesSimpleModule returns table-like File name, File type, Size, row Info links, and a Manage attachments link for each of three public pages with files. Three pages without files return No files attached to this page and the same Manage attachments link.

changes/SiteChangesListModule accepts page, perpage, pageId, categoryId, and JSON options. Pages 1 through 3 render distinct ordered rows and pager state. source and files select their revision kinds. An out-of-range page and a nonexistent category return Sorry, no revisions matching your criteria.
Two existing user:info routes render populated User Information profiles. Two nonexistent names return HTTP 200 with the exact visible error User does not exist.

A semicolon-separated category list renders the populated category regardless of whether an empty existing category comes first or last. Two missing categories return Requested forum category does not exist and a mixed numeric/non-numeric list returns Problem parsing attribute category. Two custom templates substitute documented variables; an empty category emits no item and an unknown variable stays literal.

The existing sandbox administrator receives populated ManageSite, General Settings, and PetitionAdmin output. The existing member and moderator-or-nonmember actors receive the observed administrator or permission error on all three surfaces.

Both f=image and =image accept one or two ASCII spaces and a tab between the head and source. NBSP does not act as the same separator for either head, and the ff=image and ==image lookalikes remain literal.

attempted_but_still_blocked.reason: All tag/size/perPage probes returned the no-photo diagnostic and a conflicting photoset/group probe returned a photoset failure; no provider success or network boundary appeared.
Admin received the Themes panel and B/C were denied, but no built-in ID-to-served-asset mapping appeared.
PageLookupQModule returned positive and missing JSON, but no browser keyboard/focus/loading/save/cancel interval was observed.
Members and UserInfo reads succeeded, but Watchers/WhoInvited populated producers, privacy states, and invalidation were unavailable.

ManageSite, General, Themes, and PetitionAdmin actor boundaries were observed. Dashboard denied all three actors and Clone returned Site cannot be found for all three, so those positive actor states remain unavailable.
